It can be accessed from {{Zone|The Park}} after reaching {{Skill|Foraging 12}}. == Purpose == '''Galatea''', being a {{Skill|Foraging}} island, has several Foraging-related mechanics. These include the {{Item|Heart of the Forest}}, [[Tree Gift]]s, [[Galatea#Tree Styles|Tree Styles]], {{Stat|Sweep}}, and {{Skill|Hunting}}. === Heart of the Forest === {{Main|Heart of the Forest}} The {{Item|Heart of the Forest}} is a skill tree that grants various perks related to {{Skill|Foraging}} and {{Skill|Hunting}}. One can obtain {{Turquoise|HotF EXP}} through [[Tree Gift]]s and [[Agatha|Agatha Contests]], and leveling up the '''Heart of the Forest''' or {{Green|Center of the Forest}} grants '''Token of the Forest'''. === Tree Gifts === {{Main|Tree Gift}} '''Tree Gifts''' are a bundle of loot obtained from fully cutting down a [[Fig Log|Fig]], [[Mangrove Log|Mangrove]], or [[Helix Log|Helix]] tree. Rewards obtained scale based on participation up to all rewards received at {{Green|33%}} of the tree broken: as a result, this encourages working together to chop down trees. === Tree Styles === '''Tree Styles''' dictate the order in which you cut down different parts of a tree in. Different trees have different {{Stat|toughness}}, which can be bypassed by having more {{Stat|Sweep}} than a tree's toughness. Failing to cut down a tree in the correct order results in a {{Red|50%}} less logs broken. {| class="wikitable" ! Tree ! Location ! Toughness !
